faq.q: How many butterfly species do you raise?
faq.a: We raise 12+ native butterfly species in a safe, predator-free habitat at our Miami studio. Every piece tells you which species it came from.

faq.q: Are the butterflies harmed to make these pieces?
faq.a: No. Every butterfly lives out its full, natural life cycle in our care. Only after it has naturally completed that life cycle is it respectfully preserved into art, jewelry, or a keepsake — nothing is ever harvested early.

faq.q: Can I order a custom piece?
faq.a: Yes. Most jewelry, framed art, and keepsakes can be custom designed around a species, a color palette, or an occasion. Reach out and we'll walk you through the options.
Yes. Framed art and jewelry are carefully packed to protect the piece in transit, and live caterpillar kits ship within a couple of days of your order.

faq.q: How do I book a school presentation or workshop?
faq.a: Call, text, or use the booking button on this page with your school or organization and a rough date, and we'll confirm a time for an interactive, age-appropriate presentation.

faq.q: How much does a piece cost?
faq.a: Most SK Butterflies pieces run $35 to $1,200+, depending on the piece and its complexity — a caterpillar kit is at the low end, a large commission or museum program at the high end. Every quote is clear before we start.

faq.q: Do you do butterfly releases for weddings or events?
faq.a: Yes. We provide live butterfly releases for weddings and celebrations. Because releases happen outdoors, we also send a weather advisory ahead of the date so you can plan around it.
